system.description:
The Loqren-77 are a carbonosilicate species hailing from Geuse-Lc, colloquially nicknamed Jem. Nearly every species on the planet is a primarily carbon-based arthropod inside of an often translucent or even clear silicate carapace, including plantlife. Existing in a hive structure, the loqren-77 have at least eighty distinct body formats ranging from a fairly standard beetle or insect shape to energy conducting tubes with legs ranging in size from mere centimeters to hundreds of meters. Each individual entity and body form is grown to fulfill a specific niche in loqren-77 society from energy conduit to food storage to telepathic amplifiers. Their starships are examples of incredibly large loqren- 77 that are often joined by symbiotic loqren-77 that can be replaced in case of damage, such as the aforementioned energy conduit loqren-77.

The most common body forms for adventuring or voidrunning loqren-77, however, are humanoid or quadrupedal with manipulating arms and graspers located on the forward torso. Forms which they grew new loqren-77 members into after extensive contact with alien life in order to better facilitate communication and inter-species relations. These members of the species are grown in such a way as to consume chemical nutrients in a manner similar to humans or other organic life-forms rather than engage in solar energy collection. As a result, they tend to have more opaque and soft silicon external surfaces with internal silicon support rods or ‘bones’.

While all members of the loqren-77 are capable of telepathic communication, outside of amplifiers most must rely on physical contact to communicate thoughts or images to nearby entities, so adventuring type loqren- 77 have voice boxes and mouths which allow them to engage in speech. However, there are members of the adventuring type loqren-77 which possess amplifiers as part of their growth plan and become capable of sending out telepathic messages at a distance.

The number 77 in the name of the species is not a numbering or ordering of the loqren-77 in regards to other species, planets, or body-forms. Rather, it is simply part of the name that they call themselves. It is quite common for members of the heritage to include numbers, mathematical symbols, or even equations in their names. Occasionally called “Sevens’ by alien people, the loqren-77 lightly chafe under the nickname.

Sevens Traits

Type: Humanoid. While they may take on a variety of body-plans, their sapience and material nature make them Humanoids for the purpose of spells and effects.

Age: Loqren-77 grow at an accelerated rate, often reaching physical maturity days or even hours after they’ve been hatched and they’ve been given telepathic education from the hive. However, they tend to live between 5 and 50 years, depending on their size and function.

Size: Adventuring type Loqren-77 are Small or Medium sized.

Speed: Your base speed is 30ft.

Touch Telepathy: So long as you are in physical contact with another entity, you can telepathically communicate with it, even if you do not share a language.

Photosynthetic: While exposed to the light of a natural or artificial star containing UV wavelengths, you can endure a number of days without Supply equal to your Constitution modifier before gaining fatigue.

Carapace: Due to your exoskeletal structure your armor class when unarmored is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

Sevens Gifts

Loqren-77 are an incredibly varied species which modify their members to fulfill a wide variety of roles. In addition to the traits found in your loqren-77 heritage, select one of the following sevens gifts:

Amplifier

Some adventuring type loqren-77 possess a psychic amplifier somewhere within their body, often as part of one or more hindbrains along their primary nerve cord. This amplifier works both ways, giving them increased range to their telepathic contact but also allowing them to sense certain thought-forms in the people and creatures around them.

Sense Motive: Your telepathic awareness allows you to sense motivations in the people around you, granting you expertise on Insight and Persuasion checks.

Telepathy: Your touch telepathy gains a range of 120ft and no longer requires physical contact.

Conduit

While not a conduit tube, yourself, you were grown to possess refractory lenses and conduit pathways inside your carapace in order to channel energy from, or away from, your internal organs. By flexing very tiny muscles within these conduits you can bring these lenses into alignment in order to direct focused energies.

Cutting Torch: By channeling intense light or other energies to a fine point through your fingertips, you are able to act as a cutting torch. When targeting an inanimate and stationary object within 5ft of you with this ability, you deal 4d8 radiant damage to the object as an action. You may use this action a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

Laser Channel: You may make a ranged unarmed weapon attack with your conduits. This natural weapon has a range of 60/90ft and deals 1d4 + your Dexterity modifier in radiant damage. You may use this attack once per round unless you are in an area of bright light, in which case you may make multiple attacks.

Transporter

These quadrupedal adventuring type loqren-77 are grown specifically for heavy lifting and transporting of goods or young to and from ships. Their four legs and forelimbs grow with interlocking joints and ratcheting functions that allow them to carry and maneuver an impressive amount of weight.

Bulk Goods: Grown specifically to carry large and heavy objects, you can carry an additional 2 bulky items balanced on, or strapped to, your rear torso.

Heavyweight: Your carrying capacity is tripled.

Motility: Due to your additional limbs and their ratcheting functions your speed increases by 10ft and your jumping distance doubles, so long as you do not exceed half of your carrying capacity and are not holding more than three bulky items.

Sevens Paragon Gifts

With enough time and training any loqren-77 can unlock their full physical potential. When you reach 10th level, your sevens gift dramatically improves.

Amplifier Paragon

Your amplifier helps to insulate your nervous system against psionic attacks, granting you resistance to psychic damage. If you have resistance from another source, you instead gain immunity to psychic damage.

Conduit Paragon

The damage you deal with your cutting torch increases to 6d8 and your laser channel to 1d8 + Dexterity modifier.

Transporter Paragon

You gain a climb speed of 40ft. This climb speed allows you to keep both hands free and even climb upside down on a horizontal surface.
